Willowsia Shoebotham 1917. Willowsia was previously recovered as a monophyletic taxon based on morphological data (Zhang et al. 2011), although this was hypothesized through an analysis using a single (and likely inappropriate) outgroup, Americabrya arida (Christiansen & Bellinger, 1980) . However our results, based on molecular data, corroborate previous studies on Willowsia polyphyly, as well as the nonexistence of Willowsiinae (Zhang et al. 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017; Katz et al. 2015b; Zhang & Deharveng 2015; Ding et al. 2019; Cipola & Katz 2021).
Regarding our tree, the large clade gathering the 12 Willowsia sampled taxa mixed with other Entomobryinae genera was recovered as the sister group of Neotropical scaled Entomobryinae
